item.title: Sunday 1 PM Update, Nov 22
item.description:
The Sunday one o'clock update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 22, 2026: York, Maine weather for the next 24 hours; a Delta computer outage snarls flights on the busiest stretch of the travel year, and the nation's intelligence chief is pressed on whether Vladimir Putin is a friend; Libyan officials point to Ukrainian sea drones in the Benghazi warship strike as a child is pulled alive from the rubble near Kyiv, and dozens are missing after an Indonesian candy factory fire; Treasury Secretary Bessent says the Nvidia board still owes Washington answers; OpenAI's chief scientist publishes the company's internal progress numbers and calls for industry-wide limits, while UN talks on autonomous weapons stall; a payment processor used by big software brands says card numbers and security codes were stolen; your X feed; the Seacoast's Gift of Warmth heating fund and next weekend's Nubble lights; and a family in India turning rhino dung into paper. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Sunday 10 AM Update, Nov 22
item.description:

item.title: Sunday Morning, Nov 22
item.description:

Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Saturday 4 PM Update, Nov 21
item.description:

Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
